title: Repeat a string
prompt: Implement `static string Repeat(string s, int times)` — s concatenated `times` times. `Repeat("ab", 3)` is `"ababab"`; `times` of 0 (or negative) yields `""`. Null input yields `""` too.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Exact count — count the copies, not the iterations.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Zero, negative, and null all produce the empty string — no exception.
